representative_manifest.claim_scope: statically certified CPU FP32/BF16-input proof-reference sector shield; not arbitrary backend or production-throughput parity
excluded_claims: literal arbitrary GPU, BLAS, tensor-core, fused, or compiler-reassociated parity
full optimizer, aspect scaling, weight decay, or distributed semantics
global fidelity of an arbitrary candidate

matrix_domain.input_cast: BF16->FP32 exact widening once; FP32 unchanged

operation_graph.fallback: fl32((1/2)_32*S), only if radial clipping cannot be computed
operation_graph.norm: a=maxabs(x); z=fl32(x/a); squares=fl32(z*z); fixed adjacent balanced FP32 sum; fl32(sqrt(sum)); exact float64(a)*float64(sqrt(sum))
operation_graph.radial_clip: ratio64=nextafter(Nhat(S)/Nhat(d),0); scale64=nextafter((890/2048)*ratio64,0); alpha32=nextafter(RNE32(scale64),0) unless zero; q=fl32(alpha32*d); U=fl32(fl32(gamma32*S)+q)

near_zero_and_ftz_controls.finite_precision_neighborhood: signals failing the theorem's exact-halving/normal guard belong to the explicit near-zero finite-precision neighborhood; they do not inherit exact sector output
near_zero_and_ftz_controls.ftz_policy: the locked proof backend requires gradual underflow; a backend that flushes any probe to zero fails the arithmetic contract before emitting updates
